name: rain_chibi
description: a super-deformed (chibi) girl, three heads tall - a big round head a third of her height, a short compact body, short thick arms and legs, round mitten-like hands, big chunky boots: a straight chin-length black bob with a short straight fringe, large dark eyes, a plain bright yellow rubber raincoat to mid-thigh closed down the front with yellow snap buttons, its hood down and lying flat behind the neck, plain navy-blue leggings, plain yellow rubber rain boots to just below the knee

actions.name: throw
actions.words: a throw of a snowball with the right hand

notes: The raincoat is one plain yellow all over: no dark line, stripe or seam on it anywhere - not down its sides or back, not along the inside of the sleeves or arms. The 3D render shows dark streaks there by mistake; leave them out.
